In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], during the [[Orinda campaign]], the [[Traval-Pacor system/Legends|Traval-Pacor system]] played host to a '''battle''' between the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] commanded the Remnant forces from the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']], which was supported by [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] and the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]]. They were defeated by the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. The Imperials retreated, and further showdowns awaited.
